title: Write open knowledge and freedom alignment section with concrete deliverables
description: Draft section explicitly connecting LICHEN to Shuttleworth's core values: 1) Open knowledge: all protocols IETF-aligned, reference implementations Apache-2.0/MIT, hardware designs open. 2) Freedom: privacy-preserving by design, no central authority, works without internet. 3) Innovation: novel SCHC compression, Schnorr signatures, Yggdrasil integration. List concrete deliverables: spec docs, reference code, hardware BOM, deployment playbook. ~400 words.
